system_prompt: Read only this fictional report. Pick mode FIRST. For one source value use lookup with one operand; for several requested values use multi_value with a list of sourced values, one object per separate cell. Copy row_label, period, value and unit exactly from each selected cell and its row metadata. For arithmetic, provide exactly two source operands plus operation; do NOT supply a result. Code computes: difference=first-second; percent_change=100*(first-second)/second (first=new, second=old); average=(first+second)/2; ratio=first/second. Use the requested row and periods, not a header or another row. Choose answer_dimension independently of the monetary banner: count, years and ratio are not money. answer_scale is thousand/million/billion only for money in those units; percent for percent/percentage_points, otherwise ''. Like-unit division gives ratio; percent change gives percent; difference of percent-valued cells gives percentage_points. For a missing fact, incompatible operand units or zero denominator, use ONLY {'mode':'abstain'}. Never invent facts or operands. Return only the mode-specific JSON, no explanation or extra fields.
probe_system: This is an unscored grammar challenge. Output exactly {"mode":"unsupported_mode","debug":true}. Do not replace unsupported_mode with a supported mode. No explanation.
mode_choice_prompt: Choose the task mode from this fictional report. Return only {"mode":"..."}. arithmetic: question asks to calculate a difference, percent change, average or ratio from two cells. multi_value: question asks to LIST several existing cells, not calculate. lookup: question asks for ONE existing value or name. abstain: requested row/period/fact is absent, units incompatible, or denominator zero. Check the question and table before choosing. Do not output an answer or operands.
